annotations.title: Change one passage of a page

description:
Replaces ONE passage of a post/page body, leaving everything else exactly as it was. This is the tool for FIXING a page — adding a source link, splitting a long paragraph, writing the opening sentence a check asked for. ⛔ Reach for update-content only when the whole body is genuinely being rewritten: it replaces everything, and on a page that only needed one sentence that is a rewrite nobody asked for. HOW IT WORKS: read-content first, copy the exact text you mean into `old`, put what should stand in its place in `new`. `old` must appear in the stored body EXACTLY ONCE — not found is refused (the body is not what you think, so nothing is guessed at), found twice is refused with the count (include more surrounding text until it is unique). Anchors come from read-content and nowhere else: the rendered page and the .md twin both differ from the source. THREE THINGS IT WILL NOT DO, whatever it is asked: leave a block comment half-open, empty the page, or write while somebody has the post open in the editor (their autosave would undo it minutes later). Each is refused with the reason and nothing is written. A page a page builder owns is refused too — its content is not in this body. Pass dry_run to see exactly what the edit would produce without writing it. The previous body is kept as a revision, and the answer returns its id.

Write to pass the site's AI-readability checks: keep every paragraph under about 120 words — never longer than 150 — so an engine can lift a clean, self-contained passage; prefer short sentences and plain words over long, clause-heavy ones; ground claims in concrete specifics — figures, names, versions — that the brief or well-established knowledge provides, never invented ones; and where a claim leans on official documentation or a well-known source, link it inline with <a> — only addresses you are certain exist, never a guessed URL, and only a few: the article must stay prose, not a link list.

MARKUP: scripts, event handlers, javascript: links, iframes, style elements, SVG and attributes this site does not allow in post content are refused, even under an administrator’s login, and nothing is written. Markup the owner already stored on the page stays, and is yours to keep or move, not to change or copy. Embed a video or post by its URL in an embed block. Write a literal “<” as <.

dry_run.description: True checks the edit and returns what it would produce, without writing anything.

new.description: What stands in its place. An empty string deletes the passage — allowed, as long as the page does not end up empty.

old.description: The exact text to replace, copied from read-content’s `content`. Must appear exactly once.

post_id.description: The post/page to edit — the `id` from any read-content-issues row.

name: agentimus-edit-content

changed.description: TRUE only when the body was actually written. A dry run and a no-op both answer false — report that honestly rather than as a change.

context.description: The changed passage with the text either side of it, so you can SHOW what landed instead of asserting it.

dryRun.description: TRUE when nothing was written because dry_run was asked for.

length.description: The body’s length in characters afterwards.

message.description: What happened, in the site’s own words.

revisionId.description: The revision holding the body from before this edit — the way back. 0 when nothing was written.
